dedupe_keys.name: matlab code for peril population evacuation trigger algorithm

description: Harry Mitchell and Guillermo Rein at Imperial College London publish PERIL, a MATLAB population-evacuation trigger algorithm. Zenodo provides a public source file under CC BY 4.0. The description says PERIL computes trigger perimeters for wildfire evacuation of a rural community, building on earlier work by Cova and colleagues. A planner can use these perimeters as scenario inputs for evacuation timing and route simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the public PERIL implementation. Coverage is a configured rural community and fire scenario, not a live authoritative warning boundary. A limitation is that the page does not enumerate required road topology, fire spread inputs or validation cases; those must be checked in the MATLAB source and its cited method before operational use. Trigger timing will depend on assumptions about fire travel and population response. The file was not downloaded or run, and no evacuation perimeter was independently calculated.
